_doc: pla-04 (owner-approved playability plan 2026-11-20, Burst merge): copy that supersedes the protected historical records. One verb, one shape: Burst replaces Detonate, Expend-with-damage, Discharge, Terrain Burst and Shatter Illusion; the Storm Capacitor's Arc Burst is Arc Lash; Terrain Burst's remaining enemy use is Craghide's Groundsplit.

relic_descriptions.basalt_calendar: Your @kw(burst) can destroy @term(surface_rubble) instead of @term(surface_fire), leaving @kw(surface_fire) on the destroyed tiles.
relic_descriptions.ashen_brand: Your @kw(burst) destroys all connected @term(surface_fire). A target hit by several Bursts takes 25% more damage per extra Burst.
relic_descriptions.crowncoal_heart: Once per turn, your single-target hit on a tile without @term(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified) places @kw(surface_fire). @kw(burst|Bursting) 2+ @kw(surface_fire) grants 6 @term(stoneskin), once per turn.
relic_descriptions.black_sun_dial: Each ground tile you @kw(surface_consume|Expend) or @kw(burst) gives your next attack +3 damage (up to +9).

glossary_definitions.burst: Destroys it and deals this damage to every unit on or next to its tile.
glossary_definitions.charge: At 3 Charge it unleashes Arc Lash; Shock removes 1.
glossary_definitions.detonate_cinders: Bursts the Fire on its last Cinder Marks, the dragon included.
glossary_definitions.element_fire: Fire cards place Fire ground and Burst it.
glossary_definitions.terrain_burst: Hits units around its terrain pieces.

keyword:burst: Destroys it and deals this damage to every unit on or next to its tile.
Hover the card to see every tile it hits, yours included.
keyword:terrain_burst: Hits units around its Outcrops for the shown damage.
keyword:detonate_cinders: Burst the Fire on its last Cinder Marks. Everyone caught is hit once, the dragon included.
keyword:element_fire: Card element. Fire cards mostly place Fire ground and Burst it.
combat:outcrops: Outcrop cards raise crag Outcrops on empty floor. An Outcrop blocks movement and line of sight, can be attacked like other terrain, and leaves Rubble when destroyed.
An Outcrop raise keeps floor routes connected. A raise around a target may seal the single tile it surrounds.
A powder keg blocks movement but not sight; when anything destroys it, it Bursts, setting off other kegs.
Rockburst and Worldbreak Burst terrain: Rockburst an Outcrop or crate it hits, Worldbreak an Outcrop you raised.
Raises attackable terrain with the shown Health. It blocks movement; some kinds also block sight.
combat:cinder_marks: Meteorfall strikes marked tiles and leaves Fire. When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions.
Crownfire Bursts Vyraketh's own marked Fire while it pursues you. Replace the Fire to deny the Burst, or lure the dragon into it.

The Meteorfall card marks a line of tiles the same way. The marks stay through enemy turns; at the start of your next turn, before you draw, each marked tile takes the damage (anyone standing there, including you) and becomes Fire.
Marks the shown tiles. When it lands, they take the shown damage and become Fire.
enemy:vyraketh: Fire dragon that lays marked Fire, with Cinder Droplets that leave more of it.

When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions. At half Health its Fire spreads after every second Vyraketh turn. Crownfire Bursts its own marked Fire, and its bite renews the marks.
keyword:surface_electrified: Lightning attacks travel through connected Electrified tiles, hitting enemies on them. Chain can also jump through individual Electrified tiles.
Frost Circuit turns a connected patch of Ice into Electrified ground. Discharge Bursts a connected Electrified network.
A Lightning hit that touches it spreads to every enemy on connected Electrified tiles. Chain relays through it.
combat:surface_techniques: Expend: a card that Expends a ground removes the shown ground to gain its effect. A Burst destroys ground instead (see Burst).
Convert: Frost Circuit turns the chosen Ice tile and all Ice connected to it into Electrified ground, then strikes and Shocks each enemy on the converted tiles.
Discharge: choose an Electrified tile to Burst it and every Electrified tile connected to it.
Wards leave a ground beneath each enemy next to you. Ice placed this way Chills an enemy only when it starts a turn on or enters the Ice.
keyword:charge: Gains Charge each use. At 3, its next intent is Arc Lash: lightning jumping between nearby units. Shock removes 1.
